label: Bible Study
prompt: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a _____.
verse: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
note: The faithful pilgrims longed for a better country — and God has a city ready for them.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to _____, and of great mercy.
verse: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
note: Gracious, compassionate, slow to anger, great in mercy — God's character sheet, echoing Exodus 34:6.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread _____ into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.
verse: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.
note: A Midianite dreamed a barley loaf tumbled into camp and flattened a tent — Gideon overheard and worshipped.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a _____ God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
verse: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
note: From the Ten Commandments: God's jealousy is a husband's claim on his covenant people, not petty envy.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Let us hear the _____ of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
verse: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
note: After twelve chapters of 'vanity,' the Preacher's bottom line: fear God, keep his commandments — the whole duty of man.
